entities.name: EMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by the MME after starting a common EMM procedure while waiting for a response from the UE.

entities.name: Common EMM procedure
entities.description: Generic EMM procedure initiated by the MME as referenced in clause 5.4.

entities.name: MME starts common EMM procedure

relations.description: MME starting a common EMM procedure causes transition to EMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED state.
Common EMM procedure execution requires the MME to be in EMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED state while waiting for UE response.
